四位贤者的分身
Avatars of the four Sages
贤者分身：战斗、解谜、赶路都能派上用场（游戏实机截图）
Sage avatars: useful in combat, puzzle-solving, and travel alike (in-game screenshot)
完成四地区异变与地底主线后，林克身边会跟着五位贤者的分身：风之贤者丘栗、火之贤者阿沅、水之贤者希多、雷之贤者露珠，以及魂之贤者米涅鲁。每个分身都有一个主动能力，用对了能开路、能采矿、能打怪；用错了只会觉得它们碍事。本篇按人讲清用法。

After completing the Regional Phenomena in the four regions and the Depths main quest, Link is followed by the avatars of five Sages: Tulin, Sage of Wind; Yunobo, Sage of Fire; Sidon, Sage of Water; Riju, Sage of Lightning; and Mineru, Sage of Spirit. Each avatar has an active ability: used well, they can clear paths, mine ore, and fight monsters; used badly, they just feel in the way. This guide explains each one's use, Sage by Sage.
⭐ 本篇要点
⭐ Key Points of This Guide
丘栗：滑翔时放出疾风，水平加速，赶路和上高处都靠它。
Tulin: releases a gust while gliding for horizontal acceleration — essential for travel and reaching high places.
阿沅：火焰冲撞，能采矿、碎岩、点火造上升气流，站在载具上还能当连发炮弹。
Yunobo: a fiery charge that can mine ore, break rock, and light fires to create updrafts; standing on a vehicle, it can even fire repeatedly like a cannon.
希多：水之护盾，沾水状态下卓拉武器攻击翻倍，还能用水流采矿而不炸飞矿石。
Sidon: a water shield; while Link has the wet status, Zora weapons deal double damage, and mining with water won't blast ore flying.
露珠：雷电领域内射箭，箭落点触发范围落雷，清群怪很好用。
Riju: shoot an arrow inside her lightning field and a wide-area lightning strike hits where the arrow lands — great for clearing groups of monsters.
米涅鲁：骑乘魔像，可走瘴气、浅熔岩和冰水，双臂能装武器与装置，骑乘时跳起可进林克时间。
Mineru: ride her Construct, which can cross Gloom, shallow lava, and cold water; its two arms can hold weapons and Zonai Devices, and jumping while riding enters bullet time.

常见问题
FAQ
丘栗的能力是在滑翔时放出一股水平的疾风，让林克向前加速。赶路时从鸟望台弹射出来接疾风，能飞出很远；爬高处爬到一半没力气了，跳下来滑翔接疾风也能再上一段。疾风有冷却，平时赶路可以留着，关键时刻再用。

Tulin's ability releases a horizontal gust while gliding, accelerating Link forward. When traveling, launch from a Skyview Tower and follow up with the gust to fly a long way; if you run out of stamina halfway up a climb, jump off, glide, and use the gust to gain another stretch of height. The gust has a cooldown, so you can save it during ordinary travel and use it at key moments.
阿沅会向前冲撞并带火焰，采矿、碎裂岩石、点燃草地制造上升气流都靠它。站在自造载具上时，阿沅的冲撞可以连续触发，相当于一门不用弹药的炮。打怕火的敌人和冰系敌人时，阿沅也是很好的先手。

Yunobo charges forward wreathed in flame — the go-to for mining, breaking rock, and lighting grass to create updrafts. Standing on a self-built vehicle, Yunobo's charge can trigger repeatedly, like a cannon that needs no ammunition. Yunobo is also a good opening move against enemies afraid of fire and ice-type enemies.
风之贤者丘栗
Tulin, Sage of Wind
丘栗的疾风：滑翔加速的关键（游戏实机截图）
Tulin's gust: the key to gliding acceleration (in-game screenshot)
希多的水之护盾平时是一层防护，主动触发后会给林克挂上沾水状态。沾水状态下卓拉武器攻击翻倍，这是卓拉武器流的核心配合。水流采矿还有一个好处：矿石不会被炸飞，捡起来更方便。配水盾打火系敌人也有优势。

Sidon's water shield is normally a layer of protection; triggering it actively gives Link the wet status. While wet, Zora weapons deal double damage — the core combination of a Zora-weapon build. Mining with water has another benefit: ore won't be blasted flying, so it's easier to pick up. Fighting fire-type enemies with the water shield is also advantageous.
露珠会在林克周围张开一个雷电领域，在领域内射箭，箭落点会引下一道范围落雷。清一群扎堆的敌人时，先张开领域再射一箭，落雷能一次打一片。注意领域内自己的金属武器也可能引雷，雷雨天用露珠要小心站位。

Riju opens a lightning field around Link; shoot an arrow inside the field and a wide-area lightning strike falls where the arrow lands. To clear a clustered group of enemies, open the field first and then shoot one arrow, and the strike can hit a whole area at once. Note that your own metal weapons inside the field can also attract lightning, so be careful where you stand when using Riju in a thunderstorm.
米涅鲁的分身是一具魔像，林克可以直接骑上去。魔像不怕瘴气，能走浅熔岩和冰水，双臂可以装武器和左纳乌装置，等于一个会走路的炮台。骑乘时跳起还能进入林克时间，空中射箭很好用。贤者之愿方面：全游戏共 20 个，每集齐 4 个可以在女神像处强化一位贤者为牢固盟约；强化只提升分身的攻击力，不缩短冷却、不改变功能，别指望它让能力变出新花样。

Mineru's avatar is a Construct that Link can ride directly. The Construct is immune to Gloom, can cross shallow lava and cold water, and its two arms can hold weapons and Zonai Devices — effectively a walking turret. Jumping while riding also enters bullet time, which is great for shooting arrows midair. As for Sage's Wills: there are 20 in the whole game, and every 4 collected let you upgrade one Sage to a Solemn Vow at a Goddess Statue; the upgrade only increases the avatar's attack power, it does not shorten cooldowns or change functions, so don't expect it to give abilities new tricks.
